About Me

Hi, I'm Smruti Ranjan Rout, a passionate and enthusiastic Full Stack Developer who loves building modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications.

I enjoy exploring new technologies and transforming creative ideas into practical digital solutions. I'm interested in both frontend and backend development, with a focus on clean code, problem-solving, and smooth user experiences.

I'm always eager to learn new skills, improve my technical knowledge, and take on exciting challenges. My goal is to build innovative and efficient applications while growing as a developer.

Passionate about coding, creativity, and continuous learning.
